scene_sentence_zh: 莊嚴的神殿內燭光搖曳，香氣裊繞，虔誠的信徒在神像前低聲祈禱。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: a solemn stone shrine hall interior with a carved altar on a raised dais, rows of tall wax candles with warm flickering flames, drifting incense smoke, worn stone pillars and a vaulted ceiling, a wide clear approach of polished flagstones, subdued amber candlelight against cool shadowed stone, an unobstructed open floor across the lower foreground

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: a painterly JRPG shrine hall interior — a carved stone altar on a raised dais lit by rows of tall wax candles, drifting incense smoke, worn stone pillars and a vaulted ceiling over a broad polished flagstone floor — with an unobstructed open foreground for stage figures, no interface, watermark or readable lettering, and no town/forest reuse.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop (browser method web.tests.browser.test_browser_bundled_scene_assets.BundledSceneAssetsBrowserTest.test_sacred_pack_static_decode): the full-bleed composition holds and the illustration stays distinguishable from its siblings at that viewport.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed as a three-up contact sheet beside cave_interior and dream_throne: scene identity, palette and composition are distinct for every sibling.
